titre: Production de pétrole brut du Guyana
sous_titre: Millions de barils par jour, 2025 à 2027 (estimation et prévision)

series.nom: Production de pétrole brut du Guyana

2025.texte: Crude oil production in Guyana increased by an estimated ten-fold from 2020 to 2025, when we estimate it averaged 750,000 b/d.

2027.texte: The start-up of the Uaru project in 2026 is expected to add an additional 250,000 b/d of supply, helping push crude oil production past 1.0 million b/d by 2027.
